build_FABRIK_solver: build a FABRIK inverse kinematics solver for a bone chain between a source and target bone
run_FABRIK_solve: run the FABRIK Solve method to position a bone chain toward a target position with optional pole constraint
create_FABRIK_with_pole: create a FABRIK solver and solve with a pole target to bend the chain toward a specific direction
review_FABRIK_backward_forward_pass: review the FABRIK backward and forward pass methods that iteratively adjust bone positions along the chain
summarize_FABRIK_pole_constraint: summarize the FABRIK pole constraint method that rotates joints around the chain axis using Rodrigues rotation
